compatibility_corrections.description: Installed imbalanced-learn independently in the baseline and mutant environments.
compatibility_corrections.prior_failure: The native unchanged baseline workflow failed immediately with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'imblearn'.
compatibility_corrections.reason: The frozen upstream test imports imblearn, and the upstream README objective example explicitly identifies imbalanced-learn as the package to install when that import is missing.

compatibility_corrections.description: Constrained the non-target NumPy dependency to numpy<2 independently in the baseline and mutant environments.
compatibility_corrections.prior_failure: After installing imbalanced-learn, the unchanged baseline failed in BanditOpt.HyperoptConverter because current NumPy removed np.product.
compatibility_corrections.reason: The demonstrated runtime incompatibility was caused by NumPy 2.x ecosystem drift; NumPy is not the mutation target and the repository declares only the lower bound numpy>=1.20.2.

compatibility_corrections.description: Constrained the non-target SciPy dependency to scipy<1.17 independently in the baseline and mutant environments.
compatibility_corrections.prior_failure: After the NumPy adjustment, SciPy 1.18.1 required NumPy >=2.0 and failed during sklearn import against NumPy 1.26.4.
compatibility_corrections.reason: The concretely demonstrated dependency/runtime incompatibility required a SciPy range compatible with NumPy 1.26.4 and Python 3.12; SciPy is not the mutation target and the repository declares only scipy>=1.5.1.

frozen_case.candidate_evidence: train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.2, stratify=y) -> train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.2, stratify=None)

screening.final_failure: After all three bounded corrections, the unchanged workflow returned exit status zero but every Hyperopt trial failed with 'numpy.random.mtrand.RandomState' object has no attribute 'integers' before obj_func ran. The frozen train_test_split target was therefore not exercised, so the baseline is invalid under the workflow-exercises-target rule and the mutation was not applied or evaluated.
